responsibility: This header defines the `neoverse512tvb_tunings` profile for the Neoverse 512 TVB class in the AArch64 backend. It provides a custom SVE vector-cost table and SVE issue-resource description, reuses selected Neoverse V1 scalar and AdvSIMD components, and packages the resulting Armv9-style `tune_params` including supported SVE widths, tune flags, and pair-load/store policies for code generation tuned to this Neoverse scalable-vector microarchitecture.
